one_sentence: This document claims a five-property structural isomorphism between quantum superposition and the pre-Fall moral state in Genesis 2-3.
executive_summary: This document establishes a Level 3 structural isomorphism between quantum superposition and the pre-Fall moral state in Eden. It maps five defining properties of superposition—coexistence of eigenstates, indeterminacy without measurement, irreversible collapse, observer-determined outcome, and post-collapse regime change—onto five attested properties of the pre-Fall world from Genesis 2-3. The mapping passes all four separator tests (structural preservation, non-arbitrariness, constraint, bidirectionality) and is independently confirmed by the phase transition potential V(φ) = -μ²φ² + λφ⁴. The conclusion is that both phenomena manifest the same five-property architecture because they are expressions of the same substrate at different measurement scales.
short_summary: This document is a formal isomorphism paper mapping quantum superposition to the pre-Fall moral state in Eden. The core structural claim is that five properties of superposition—coexistence, indeterminacy, irreversible collapse, observer-determined outcome, and regime change—map one-to-one onto Genesis 2-3. Key evidence includes the five-property mapping table, four separator tests, and independent confirmation from phase transition symmetry-breaking. This matters because it suggests a universal structural signature of the substrate underlying both physics and theology.
